QuestInfo.name: The Snowy Valley
QuestInfo.0: Light a #p9074401# and take a look around you.
QuestInfo.1: This sort of looks like El Nath, but you can't figure out how you got here. Maybe you'll have better luck if you can get out of the valley.
QuestInfo.2: The valley looks deep and treacherous.

0.0: This place looks like El Nath. But how did I end up here? All I did was touch #p9074200#'s painting--OH CRAP. Am I stuck in a painting?! I'm gonna kill #p9074200# when I see him!
0.1: First, I've gotta get out of this valley before I freeze. Then, I find #p9074200# and pull that stupid hat down around his ears.
